title: A Grammar of French Civil Cassation: A Ground-Level Dataset and Tool
abstract: arXiv:2610.31116v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper presents a dataset of 121,536 ground-reasons pairs across 86,464 rulings of the five civil chambers of the French Court of Cassation (2016-2025). An appeal on points of law cannot itself be appealed and often decides a case for good. Understanding how the Court rules is thus crucial and can help lawyers who draft those appeals. Inside a ruling, every ground of appeal (a distinct legal complaint against the appealed decision) has its own answer from the Court. This answer is called the reasons and it belongs to one of a few doctrinal families. Using a deterministic pipeline, we pair each ground with its reasons and attach the pair to its family, according to the established French taxonomy. We obtain a descriptive grammar of civil cassation that shows which grounds succeed, which legal texts they refer to, and how both evolve over the decade. We release the dataset, the code and an interactive consultation tool.

translated_title: 法国民事撤销审的“语法”：一个基础层面的数据集与工具
translated_abstract: 本文发布了一个数据集，涵盖法国最高法院五个民事庭（2016-2025年）86,464份判决中的121,536对“上诉理由-法院回应”配对。针对法律问题的撤销审上诉本身不可再上诉，且往往一锤定音地决定案件结局，因此理解该法院如何裁判至关重要，并能帮助起草此类上诉的律师。在一份判决中，每个上诉理由（针对被上诉裁决的一项独立法律异议）都对应法院的一个回应，即“理由”，它属于少数几个教义学类别之一。我们利用一个确定性流程，将每个上诉理由与其对应的法院回应配对，并依据法国既定的分类法将配对归入相应类别。由此，我们获得了一部民事撤销审的描述性“语法”，展示哪些上诉理由能够胜诉、援引了哪些法律条文，以及二者在十年间的演变。我们公开了数据集、代码和交互式查询工具。
tldr: 该研究通过确定性流程构建了法国最高法院民事庭86,464份判决中121,536对“上诉理由-法院回应”的配对数据集，并将其归入既定教义学类别，形成了一部揭示民事撤销审上诉成败规律及其十年演变的描述性“语法”。
en_tdlr: The paper builds a dataset of 121,536 ground-reasons pairs from 86,464 rulings of the French Court of Cassation's civil chambers (2016-2025) using a deterministic pipeline, classifying each pair into doctrinal families to yield a descriptive grammar showing which grounds of appeal succeed and how they evolve over the decade.
